image_description: A close-up, macro-style photograph of a lionfish (Pterois) against a dark background. The image focuses on the head and anterior body, showcasing the characteristic reddish-brown and white vertical stripes. Prominent features include large, fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays and dorsal spines extending upward. The eye is visible but partially obscured by the angle and lighting.

There is slight edge bleeding between the fin tips and the dark background, suggesting a lack of sharp optical separation typical of real macro photography.
